title: VP of Customer Success
locations: India / India-eligible remote; verify on listing
jobDescription: Time Doctor is hiring a VP of Customer Success to own retention across a global base of 10k+ customers spanning a hybrid product-led and sales-led business. The foundation is built: a rebuilt Customer Success Playbook, three teams in place, and a clear operating model. Your mandate is to make it perform — and to build customer success as an AI-first function from the ground up. You’ll report to the CEO, partner closely with the CRO and revenue team, and lead Account Management, Support, and Solutions as one integrated post-sale organization. Who we are Time Doctor is a workforce analytics platform that provides distributed teams the visibility they need to improve trust and performance. We serve remote, hybrid, and outsourced/shared services organizations worldwide, especially in BPO, healthcare, and tech services. We’re bootstrapped, profitable, and fully remote, with about 125 people across 30+ countries. We’ve built a durable business on customer revenue, not venture capital. Now we’re scaling it. The role You’ll lead everything that happens after the sale — Account Management, Support, and Solutions (including onboarding) — as one integrated function with one job: keep and grow every dollar of customer revenue. Three things make this seat different from most VP of Customer Success roles: The number. You own Net Revenue Retention outright — protecting revenue through renewals and saves, and growing it through an owned expansion number driven in partnership with our CRO and revenue team. Retention is our #1 company priority, and this role is where it lives. The playbook. We’ve already rebuilt the CS Playbook from the ground up: account segmentation and tiering, AM pod structure, health scoring, engagement plans (save, revenue, and success plans), EBRs, and a defined operating cadence with renewal and expansion processes. This is not a build-the-process-from-scratch role — it’s a lead-and-execute role. Your job is disciplined, consistent execution across a global remote team, and sharpening the system with data as we scale. The operating model. You’ll operate as a player/coach in an AI-first organization — building and orchestrating agents yourself, embedding them in daily operations, working side by side with Account Managers, and scaling a lean team that does the same. Who you are You wake up thinking about retention — every renewal, every save, every expansion opportunity in the base. You hold yourself to a simple standard: no surprise churn. Risk gets caught early and worked hard. Always. You see sales leaders as partners, not rivals for credit — a shared revenue goal with the CRO is what excites you. You’re happiest in the work: side by side with an AM on a save plan, or in front of a customer’s executive team. You run systems with discipline. A playbook is only as good as its execution, and execution is your craft. Today’s AI landscape energizes you, it doesn’t scare you. You "nerd out" on agents and automation — and you build first, delegate second. Entrepreneurial and scrappy: you deliver results without waiting for the perfect budget or team size. You’re competitive, hungry, and coachable — you’ve been coached, you seek out coaches, and you look for every edge you can get. What you’ll own The number. Net Revenue Retention across the installed base — Gross Revenue Retention and churn as the floor, plus an owned expansion number: identifying, qualifying, and driving upsell, cross-sell, and seat growth in partnership with the CRO and revenue team, with shared pipeline visibility and clean handoffs. Playbook execution. Disciplined, consistent execution of the CS Playbook across every pod and region — segmentation, engagement statuses and plans, health scoring, EBRs, and the weekly/monthly/quarterly cadence — refined with data, not rebuilt on instinct. Key accounts. Executive sponsorship of our most strategic customers. You personally own senior stakeholder relationships, step into high-risk renewals and escalations, and drive them to fast decisions. Onboarding and time-to-value. Implementation and early lifecycle outcomes through the Solutions team, so customers see value fast and stay. The support experience. Service quality, responsiveness, and effectiveness across regions and segments. The AI-first operating model. Agents and automation embedded in daily CS operations — risk detection, customer coverage, EBR prep, support responsiveness, reporting — so a lean team outproduces a big one. The team. Hire, develop, and lead team leads and ICs across Account Management, Support, and Solutions in multiple time zones — and grow their AI fluency so they build and scale their own agentic workflows. This role is NOT for you if… You manage retention from a dashboard and don’t like a calendar full of customer calls. This is a hands-on role — side by side with AMs, in the accounts, in the escalations. "AI experience" on your resume means your team uses Chat GPT sometimes. We need someone who has personally built and orchestrated agent workflows that ship real work and deliver real outcomes. You need to design your own process to succeed. The playbook is built. We need it led, executed, and sharpened — not reinvented in your image. You’ve only ever served one motion. If you’ve done pure self-serve or pure enterprise sales-led — but never both at once — this will be a hard job. You think customer success means managing a support queue, or you measure your team on activity instead of revenue outcomes. Your first instinct is to add headcount. We run lean by design — leverage comes from focus, systems, and AI, not staff. You’ve only ever led co-located teams. Our customers and our team span the globe. Requirements What a realistic week looks like A renewal-risk working session with an AM Director, going deep on two save plans. An executive sponsor call with a strategic BPO account, then a same-day decision on an escalation you pulled the right people into. An expansion pipeline review with the CRO. Inspecting health-score movement and cadence adherence across regions — and holding a team lead accountable where it slipped. Shipping an agent workflow that flags at-risk accounts a quarter earlier — then teaching the team to build the next one. Live collaboration during Eastern Time hours with async updates for teammates in other time zones. Reporting NRR, churn, and save rate to the Senior Leadership team with zero fluff. Your experience 8+ years of post-sale leadership in B2B Saa S — Customer Success, Account Management, or equivalent — including 3+ years leading managers and multi-function teams. A proven, measurable track record of improving Net Revenue Retention and reducing churn in a growth-stage B2B Saa S company — you know your numbers cold and can walk us through them. Owned or co-owned expansion revenue, partnering effectively with sales leadership on account growth. Served a global customer base and led distributed remote teams across regions, cultures, and time zones — effective both live and async. Operated a hybrid revenue model spanning product-led/self-serve and sales-led motions. Hands-on AI builder: you’ve personally designed and deployed agent workflows and automation in CS or service operations, can name your stack, and can show what it shipped. A record of driving disciplined execution of defined playbooks and operating models — you make systems run, not just design them. Executive presence and credibility with senior customer stakeholders, including in escalations and renewal-risk situations. Comfortable hands-on with CS tooling, CRM, and product usage data. Hub Spot experience is a plus. Based in North America, with working hours that overlap Eastern Time and the ability to travel 10-20%, including occasional international travel. Nice to have Background in workforce analytics, workforce/talent management, HR tech, or productivity software. Experience serving BPO/outsourcing, healthcare, or tech services customers. Experience across SMB, mid-market, and strategic/enterprise segments, including digital or scaled CS programs. How we’ll measure success Net Revenue Retention — including delivery against an owned expansion number. Gross Revenue Retention and churn against baseline. Playbook execution quality — engagement plan coverage, cadence adherence, health score accuracy. Faster time-to-value and stronger product adoption. Save rate and renewal readiness. Support quality and resolution across regions. More output per person because of the AI systems you’ve built — and a healthy, productive team that stays. Why this role Own the single biggest lever in our growth plan — with real authority over the outcomes you’re measured on. Participate in the upside. Competitive comp tied to company outcomes you help generate. Report directly to the CEO with a real seat at the leadership table. Profitable, growing company — your budget comes from customers, not a burn rate. The playbook is built and the teams are in place — you get to make it perform, not clean up a mess. Build the AI-first customer success playbook from the front, instead of inheriting someone else’s. Fully remote and flexible — work with talented people in 30+ countries, and travel to some awesome places. Our Hiring Approach 🌍 This is a full-time, 100% remote role , giving you the freedom to work from anywhere. 🤝 Equal opportunity employer — we deeply value diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability. 🗺️ We hire globally . Depending on your location, you may join as a full-time employee or contractor. Our Talent Attraction team will walk you through all the details during your first interview. Who are we? We’re a global team building the future of workforce analytics, focused on visibility, trust, performance, and growth. Our mission is to empower people and companies thrive in the modern world of work, while giving business leaders the confidence to scale. We’re a fully remote, async-first company with 150+ team members across 35+ countries. We collaborate across time zones and cultures and value thoughtful, data-informed decision-making. We’re looking for globally minded people who want to help shape the future of work through data, trust, and empowered leadership. Learn more about us here: Originally posted on Himalayas

jobDescription: Time Doctor | Remote — North America | Reports to the CEO Time Doctor is hiring a VP of Marketing to own the pipeline and revenue funnels that fuel growth across a hybrid product-led and sales-led business: a profitable, global Saa S company with an established customer base (10k+ customers), two working revenue motions (PLG + Sales-Led), a next-generation AI product headed to market — and a mandate to build marketing as an AI-first function from the ground up. The role You'll lead all of marketing — demand generation, content, brand, product, customer and partner marketing — as one integrated function with one job: both revenue funnels full, always. Two things make this seat different from most VP Marketing roles: The motion. Time Doctor runs a true hybrid model: a self-serve funnel where users sign up, try, and buy on their own, and a sales-led funnel where marketing feeds and accelerates the sales team. You'll own both funnels and the handoffs between them, informed by real product usage and GTM data — across multiple major markets globally. The operating model. This is a building role. You'll design an AI-first marketing organization — building and orchestrating agents yourself, embedding them in daily operations, and scaling a lean team that does the same. You'll operate as a player/coach: setting strategy with the CEO and CRO, then executing alongside your team. Who you are You wake up thinking about pipeline — new ways to solve hard marketing problems that drive revenue. Entrepreneurial and growth-obsessed: you're here to build a business, not run a department. You see revenue leaders as partners, not internal customers — working toward a shared company goal is what excites you. You move fast and take smart chances: experiment, learn, and fail fast — you'd rather try and miss than sit still. Today's marketing landscape energizes you, it doesn't scare you. You "nerd out" on the newest tools, tech, and best practices — and you're first to try them. You hold yourself to a simple standard: sales is fed and the funnel is full. Always. You've been coached, you seek out coaches, and you look for every edge you can get. You're competitive, hungry, and motivated by the work you do — you wake up excited to build every day. What you'll own The number. You own filling both revenue funnels — New Business & Expansion pipeline for the sales team, and high-quality PQLs (engaged, ICP-fit trials) for the self-serve funnel, with direct accountability for cost of acquisition. Two funnels, one strategy. One integrated go-to-market across two motions. You decide how budget, channels, and messaging split between self-serve and sales-led to fill both funnels with quality revenue. Growth converts PQLs into activations; the CRO owns revenue. Your job: neither funnel is ever the reason we miss. Global positioning. How Time Doctor is positioned and differentiated across multiple major markets and ICP segments, in a competitive, trust-sensitive category. Brand and content. A content engine that drives organic growth, SEO/GEO and feeds every other marketing function. Product marketing. Positioning, launches, and sales enablement — including bringing our next-generation product to market in partnership with Product. Customer marketing. Expansion campaigns, lifecycle programs, advocacy, and customer stories that drive Net Revenue Retention. Partner marketing. Co-marketing programs, partner enablement, and campaigns that turn our partner ecosystem into a revenue source — integrations, resellers, and affiliates feeding both funnels. The AI-first operating model. Agents and automation embedded in daily marketing operations — demand gen, conversion, content, campaign ops, personalization, analysis, reporting — so a lean team outproduces a big one. You'll set the standard for how the whole company applies AI. The team. Hire, develop, and lead a lean team (currently ~4) across multiple time zones, and grow their AI fluency so they can build/scale their own agentic teams. The budget. Ownership of spend across channels, funnels, and markets, plus the contractors, freelancers, and martech stack that extend the team. Outside resources are leverage, not a crutch: every dollar you spend comes from a customer. This role is NOT for you if… Your first instinct is to hire agencies and add headcount. We run lean by design — leverage comes from focus, systems, and AI — not staff. "AI experience" on your resume means your team uses Chat GPT sometimes. We need someone who has personally built and orchestrated agent workflows that ship real work and deliver real outcomes. You've only ever marketed to one motion. If you've done pure PLG or pure enterprise sales-led — but never both at once — this will be a hard job. You've only ever marketed to one market or region. We sell globally, across multiple major markets and segments. You optimize for vanity metrics and impressions. We optimize for pipeline, revenue, and cost of acquisition. You want to set strategy and delegate from a distance. This is a hands-on, in-the-work leadership role. Requirements What a realistic week looks like A pipeline working session with the CRO. Reviewing a PQL routing experiment with the Growth team. Shipping an agent workflow that doubles demo requests — then teaching the team to build the next one. Rewriting the homepage conversion flow because you had a better idea. Inspecting the funnel and bringing an issue to brainstorm with the GTM leaders on your weekly call. Live collaboration during Eastern Time hours with your team, plus async updates for teammates in other time zones. Reporting pipeline, CAC, and funnel conversion to the Senior Leadership team with zero fluff. Your experience 8+ years in B2B Saa S marketing, including senior leadership across multiple marketing functions. Ran marketing in a hybrid product-led + sales-led model — you can talk in detail about self-serve conversion AND sales pipeline generation, and how you made them reinforce each other. Brought a new product to market: you've led positioning, launch, and go-to-market for a significant new product or product generation — in this category or another. Served more than one major market, including global/international audiences — you've localized positioning, channels, and campaigns across regions. Direct, measurable ownership of pipeline, cost of acquisition, and revenue contribution — you know your numbers cold. Hands-on AI builder: you've personally designed and deployed agent workflows and automation in marketing operations, can name your stack, and can show what it shipped. Led lean, remote teams across time zones — effective both live and async. Resourceful operator: you've built growth without waiting for the perfect budget or team size. Comfortable hands-on with marketing automation, CRM, and analytics. Hub Spot experience strongly preferred. Based in North America, with working hours that overlap Eastern Time. Nice to have Background in workforce analytics, workforce/talent management, HR tech, or productivity software. Experience marketing to BPO/outsourcing, healthcare, or tech services buyers. Experience selling to mid-market customers with a global footprint. How we'll measure success New Business & Expansion pipeline delivered to the sales team. PQL volume and quality — engaged, ICP-fit trials delivered to Growth. Cost of acquisition and overall marketing efficiency. Growth in organic traffic and LLM brand presence across our markets. Launches that drive new business, expansion and adoption. Retention and expansion influenced by customer marketing. More output per person because of the AI systems you've built — and a healthy, productive team that stays. Why this role Participate in the upside. Competitive comp tied to company outcomes you help generate. Report directly to the CEO (a prior CMO) with a real seat at the leadership table. Profitable, growing company — your budget comes from customers, not a burn rate. A next-generation AI product to bring to market — with the launch playbook yours to write. Build the AI-first marketing playbook from the front, instead of inheriting someone else's. Fully remote and flexible — work with talented people in 30+ countries.
